name: NORTH7 Market Intelligence
description: Financial intelligence infrastructure for AI agents. Provides AI-analyzed trading signals, risk assessment, market regime detection, and decision intelligence for 80+ global assets. Unlike raw data APIs, NORTH7 delivers decision-ready signals with confidence scores and reasoning.

skills.name: Assess Market Risk
skills.description: Get the global market risk index (0-100) with active crises and regional breakdown. No API key needed.
examples: What is the current market risk level?
Are there any active crises affecting markets?
Is it safe to trade right now?

skills.name: Detect Market Regime
skills.description: Determine if the market is in BULL, BEAR, SIDEWAYS, or CRISIS mode based on S&P 500 and VIX. No API key needed.
examples: Is the market bullish or bearish?
What is the current market trend?
Should I go long or short?

skills.name: Get Trading Signals
skills.description: Real-time AI-analyzed trading signals from 6 sources: news, alpha screening, stock radar, intraday scanner, commodity scoring. Each signal has direction, confidence score, and reasoning.
examples: What are the latest trading signals?
Any buy signals for tech stocks?
What does the AI recommend trading today?

skills.name: Get Real-Time Prices
skills.description: Live prices for 80+ assets including stocks, ETFs, commodities, and forex. Updated every 2 minutes.
examples: What is the current price of AAPL?
Show me gold and oil prices
Get prices for MSFT, TSLA, AMZN

skills.name: Analyze Stock
skills.description: Deep AI analysis of a specific stock with fundamentals, technicals, and AI assessment.
examples: Analyze Tesla stock
What are the fundamentals of MSFT?
Should I buy Apple?

skills.name: Daily Intelligence Briefing
skills.description: AI-generated daily briefing covering geopolitics, market-moving events, and forward-looking analysis. Available in English and German.
examples: Give me today's market briefing
What geopolitical events are affecting markets?
Daily intelligence report

skills.name: Commodity Analysis
skills.description: AI scoring for 15 raw materials (gold, oil, wheat, coffee etc.) with seasonal patterns.
examples: What are the commodity signals?
Is gold a buy right now?
Coffee and cocoa analysis

skills.name: Sector Radar
skills.description: Sector rotation analysis showing which sectors lead or lag the market.
examples: Which sectors are outperforming?
Show me sector rotation data
Best performing sectors right now

skills.name: Model Portfolio
skills.description: Current positions and performance of the NORTH7 AI model portfolio.
examples: What is the model portfolio holding?
Show me the AI portfolio performance

pricing.note: 3 endpoints completely free without API key
